spans.s: रथ m. 1. A carriage, a chariot, a war-chariot; 2. the body; 3. the foot; 4. a limb, a part; 5. reed.
रथ-अक्ष m. a carriage-axle.
रथ-अंग (I) n. 1. any part of a carriage, especially the wheels, उपोढशब्दा न रथांगनेमयः Sak.vii.; 2. a disc, especially the disc of Viṣṇu; 3. a potter’s wheel or lathe.
रथ-अंग (II) m. the ruddy goose.
